  • M7 Ultra reportedly to feature up to 1.5TB of memory, finally matching 2019 Mac Pro levels
  • Apple is developing a new-generation Apple Pencil, expected to launch next year, possibly with a swappable battery design
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max component costs may rise by nearly US$300
  • Apple lawsuit hasn't impacted OpenAI hardware launch timeline
